name: Yamaha Virago 535
engine: 535 cc air-cooled SOHC V-twin, two carbs, shaft drive
intro: A light, easy cruiser. Starting problems usually trace to the battery, the starter or the starter clutch.

add.title: Check the starter system
add.instructions: Test the battery first. Then check that the starter engages cleanly. A starter that spins freely points at the starter clutch.
add.reason: A worn starter clutch is a common cause of no-start on these bikes.
add.src: Cafe Racer Webshop XV535 kit notes

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
